name: diag_look_flip_existing_01
command:
import json
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from src.tools import merge_pair_v2 as merge
from src.tools.t01v2_look_unit_review_checkpoint import source_support
from src.tools.t01v2_posthoc_solvability import verified_passed_rows
from src.tools.t01v2_look_funnel import summarize
sources = [
 "pilot_pairs_v2_look100_seq_01_j707546_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan203",
 "pilot_pairs_v2_look100_seq_01_j707546_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan204",
 "pilot_pairs_v2_look60_seq_01_j707558_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan203",
 "pilot_pairs_v2_look60_seq_01_j707558_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan204"]
for name in sources:
 with source_support():
  data, source = merge.load_source(merge.ROOT / "results" / (name + ".json"))
 cfg, metrics = data["config"], data["metrics"]
 eligibility, journal_ref, passed = verified_passed_rows(data)
 if journal_ref is None:
  print(json.dumps({"source": source, "journal": None, "diagnostic": "unknown"})); continue
 rows = [json.loads(line) for line in merge.reference_path(journal_ref, within=merge.ROOT / "data/world_pairs/v2").read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
 raw_rows, modes, reasons, targets, target_missing = [], Counter(), defaultdict(Counter), Counter(), 0
 for row in rows:
  raw = merge.read_reference(row["raw_attempt"], within=cfg["raw_evidence_dir"])
  if any(raw.get(key) != row.get(key) for key in ("pair_id", "scene", "status", "discard_reasons")):
   raise ValueError("Raw/journal identity mismatch")
  mode = raw.get("mode", "unknown")
  modes[mode] += 1
  reasons[mode].update(raw.get("discard_reasons") or [])
  raw_rows.append({**raw, "source_file": source["file"], "raw_attempt": row["raw_attempt"]})
  if mode == "flip" and "target_uniqueness_or_ratio" in (raw.get("discard_reasons") or []):
   if isinstance(raw.get("target_measurements"), list):
    targets.update(reason for target in raw["target_measurements"] for reason in target.get("reasons", []))
   else: target_missing += 1
 native_modes, native_reasons = Counter(), defaultdict(Counter)
 for failure in metrics.get("placement_point_failures") or []:
  raw = merge.read_reference(failure["raw_attempt"], within=cfg["raw_evidence_dir"])
  mode = raw.get("mode", "unknown")
  native_modes[mode] += 1
  native_reasons[mode].update(raw.get("discard_reasons") or [])
 views = {}
 for catalog in metrics.get("pool_catalogs") or []:
  key = json.dumps(catalog["view"], sort_keys=True)
  cell = views.setdefault(key, {"view": catalog["view"], "catalogs": [], "retained_A_B_distribution": Counter(), "before_cap_A_B_distribution": Counter()})
  counts = catalog.get("counts") or {}
  a, b = [(counts.get(side) or {}).get("look") or {} for side in ("A", "B")]
  retained, before = [a.get("retained"), b.get("retained")], [a.get("before_cap"), b.get("before_cap")]
  cell["retained_A_B_distribution"][str(retained)] += 1
  cell["before_cap_A_B_distribution"][str(before)] += 1
  cell["catalogs"].append({"identity": catalog.get("identity"), "retained_A_B": retained, "before_cap_A_B": before,
    "flip_domain_nonempty": all(type(v) is int and v > 0 for v in retained) if all(type(v) is int for v in retained) else None,
    "reference": catalog.get("reference")})
 result = {"source": source, "eligibility": eligibility, "journal": journal_ref, "counted_attempts_by_mode": dict(modes),
  "counted_rejections_by_mode": {key: dict(value) for key, value in reasons.items()},
  "native_placement_failures_not_counted_by_mode": dict(native_modes),
  "native_failure_reasons_by_mode": {key: dict(value) for key, value in native_reasons.items()},
  "target_reasons_in_retained_flip_measurements": dict(targets), "flip_ratio_rejections_with_omitted_target_measurements": target_missing,
  "pool_counts_by_view": list(views.values()),
  "flip_funnel": summarize([row for row in raw_rows if row.get("mode") == "flip"]),
  "scope": "existing authenticated source-recorded pools/attempts only; no new rendering or physics; missing compact target measurements remain unknown"}
 print("FLIP_EXISTING_DIAGNOSTIC_JSON: " + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False), flush=True)
